findings.detail: OpenCode derives the agent identifier from the filename; the file is named after the logical name and there is no name field.
The description is emitted as native frontmatter used for selection.
The Markdown body is the agent's system prompt.

Agent Skills are copied to .opencode/skills, where OpenCode discovers them project-wide and the skill tool loads them on demand; the catalog is not private to this agent.
Plugin skills are copied to .opencode/skills. MCP servers are configured in opencode.json, where they are available to every agent in the project, not only the declaring one.
permission.task is OpenCode's per-agent subagent allowlist; each listed agent runs as a bounded task through the Task tool and returns its result to the caller.
